documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: We are an existing customer in manufacturing. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer is an existing manufacturing client experiencing workflow disruption due to a configuration change. They explicitly stated that their workflow 'stopped after a configuration change' and requested support involvement before any expansion discussions. This is identified as a support incident, not a sales opportunity.

claims.quote: Please get support involved before discussing expansion.

raw_proposal.draft: We understand that your workflow has stopped following a configuration change, and we appreciate your request to involve support before considering any expansion. Our support team is available to assist with resolving this issue. Please provide them with any details you have about the configuration change to help expedite the resolution.
questions: What specific configuration change caused the workflow disruption?
Have you already contacted the support team for assistance?
uncertainties: The exact nature of the configuration change is unknown.
The current status of the support incident is not provided.
